description: This file implements a Translation Memory system that loads, manages, and persists translation entries stored in a JSONL format. It provides functionalities to load translation data from a file, retrieve entries by cache key, add new entries, and save the data back to disk.

classes.name: TMEntry
classes.description: Represents a single translation memory entry containing source text, translation, and relevant metadata.

classes.name: TranslationMemory
classes.description: Manages a collection of translation entries loaded from and saved to a file, supporting retrieval and update operations.

methods.name: LoadTranslationMemory
methods.description: Loads translation entries from a specified file, parsing JSON lines into TMEntry objects and storing them in the TranslationMemory.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a translation entry by cache key if it exists and has a non-empty translation.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Adds or updates a translation entry in the memory collection.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Serializes the current collection of translation entries back to the JSONL file, creating a temporary file and then atomically renaming it.
